name: Gut-VLM
description: Gut-VLM is a multimodal image-text dataset for gastrointestinal image analysis designed to study hallucination in vision-language models. It includes medical images paired with descriptive reports, annotated for hallucinated sentences and their corrections, enabling hallucination-aware finetuning and evaluation of VLMs in the medical domain.
reputation: A specialized medical multimodal benchmark that is useful for studying hallucination in vision-language models, but not yet widely established as a standard benchmark.
notes: Dataset includes hallucination tags and corrections; focuses on hallucination-aware finetuning rather than only report generation.
